title: Players he went to hear in his early New York days
summary: Off work he liked hearing Budd Johnson, Zoot Sims, Gerry Mulligan, Maurice Mark, Stan Getz and Red Norvo.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: In the time that you had off from work, say in the early days, who would you make a point of going to see...you've said quite a bit about your heroes, Coleman Hawkins and whatever, but were there other people, perhaps lesser known people around at that time that you...

Well, let me think, that I really liked, let's see..I can't think right now, but there were some people. Oh, I liked to hear Budd Johnson play, you know, and I liked to hear Zoot Sims play and I liked to hear Gerry Mulligan. I liked the way he played. Maurice Mark, I liked the way he played. I liked Stan Getz, you know. He was playing very well at that time. I liked to listen to Red Norvo, you know.
